question: How does a participant track an assigned shared balance?

sections.beforeHtml: When your shared assignment stays active, personal Trip expenses becomes the place where shared payments are recorded against that balance.
items: Open Dashboard > Trip personal > Expenses for the selected trip.
Open the collapsible My shared balance panel to review your assigned, paid, remaining, or overpaid shared balance.
Add or update personal expenses with Shared payment turned on when you want those expenses to count toward the shared balance.
Use payment method, recipient, amount, notes, currency, and rate the same way you use them on normal personal expenses.
Review the expense status text when you want to distinguish shared payments from personal expenses and money transfers.
Return to Trip personal > Participants if you need to review the assignment status or change the Rejected state on your own participant row.
sections.afterHtml: My shared balance tracks one participant`s own shared assignment. The trip-level expenses overview on Trip shared expenses and Trip participants tracks the whole trip instead.
